# Conor O'Shea Fitness

> A structured, three-phase remote coaching program (Reset, Restore, Reinforce) for chronic low back pain, built by Conor O'Shea after rebuilding his own L5-S1 disc bulge and herniation. He has coached 400+ clients since 2011.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://conorosheafitness.com/): Program overview, Conor's L5-S1 injury story, and the three-phase method.
- [Method](https://conorosheafitness.com/#method): The three phases of the program - Reset (drop load, calm the system), Restore (rebuild movement capacity), Reinforce (return to normal training).
- [FAQ](https://conorosheafitness.com/#faq): Answers on remote coaching, non-specific back pain, program length, and training with a disc injury.
- [Client stories](https://conorosheafitness.com/testimonials.html): Video client interviews, podcast episodes, and client message screenshots.
- [Articles](https://conorosheafitness.com/articles.html): Posts synced from Conor's Substack newsletter, with a link to subscribe.
- [About](https://conorosheafitness.com/about.html): Conor O'Shea's background, the L5-S1 injury story, and how the coaching program is run remotely.

## Take action
- [Free assessment](https://lowbackassessment.conorosheafitness.com/): Free 8-10 minute online self-assessment quiz of current back pain status.
- [Book an Assessment Call](https://app.aura-app.ai/conor-o-shea-fitness-ltd/assessmentlink): Free 45-minute live assessment call with Conor, distinct from the free online self-assessment quiz above. This is the site's main "Book a Call" link.

## Optional
- [Substack](https://conorosheafit.substack.com/): Conor's newsletter, source for the articles page.
